title: External Bible API call has no timeout
reasoning: get_passage performs a blocking requests.Session.get against an external service without a timeout. A stalled TCP connection or unresponsive API can tie up a Django request thread or background worker indefinitely, and callers only handle exceptions after the request returns or fails at the transport layer.
recommendation: Pass an explicit connect/read timeout to session.get, preferably configurable via settings with a conservative default, and let requests.Timeout be handled by the existing error path.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included, and a normal mocked success response would not expose indefinite blocking behavior from a missing timeout.
suggestedRegressionTest: Unit test get_passage with a mocked session.get and assert it is called with the configured timeout value.
